f AS (SELECT s.store_id, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc_all, sum(f.net_amount) nb_all, sum(f.quantity) u_all,
  count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT f.staff_purchase_flag) rc_ns, sum(f.net_amount) FILTER (WHERE NOT f.staff_purchase_flag) nb_ns
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY 1)

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.format,
  count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
  round(sum(f.net_amount) / count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv_net_ex_staff,
  round(sum(f.gross_amount) / count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv_gross_ex_staff
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  AND f.channel_id = 1 AND s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY s.format
